# NetFrame (full reference for LLM agents)

> Cyberpunk CSS component library by Cybear Technologies. Plain CSS, no JavaScript runtime. Docs: https://netframe.cybeartech.com

Generated from the repository by `scripts/build-skills.mjs`.

---

<!-- skill: netframe-interactive -->

# Interactive NetFrame patterns

NetFrame ships styles only. Open/closed and selected state is read from ARIA attributes and `hidden`, so your JavaScript sets those. `references/patterns.md` has the reference markup and a controller for each pattern. These are the docs' own snippets, executed by the NetFrame browser test suite, so prefer them over rewriting.

## Principles

1. **State in attributes, literal strings.** Write `aria-expanded="true"` or `"false"` and `aria-hidden="true"` or `"false"`. The CSS hides menus only for `aria-hidden="true"` or `.nf-hidden`; toggling the attribute on and off will not hide them.
2. **Keyboard parity.** Every pointer action has a key: Enter/Space activate, Escape closes, arrow keys move within menus and tab lists, Home/End jump. Disabled items are skipped.
3. **Manage focus.** Opening a menu focuses its first item; Escape returns focus to the trigger. Modals and drawers trap focus, make the page behind `inert`, and restore focus on close.
4. **Link controls to content.** Tabs and accordion triggers use `aria-controls` pointing at a real `id`. Give every instance unique ids.
5. **Collapsed content stays out of the tab order.** Use `hidden` or `inert`, not just `height: 0`.
6. **Text, not HTML.** Build dynamic content (toasts, notifications) with `textContent` or DOM APIs. Never inject untrusted strings with `innerHTML`.
7. **Announce changes.** Toast regions are polite live regions; error toasts use `role="alert"`. Update counts and status text alongside any visual change.
8. **Respect reduced motion.** The accordion controller skips its height animation under `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce`; honour the setting in any animation you add.

## Choosing a pattern

| Need | Pattern in `references/patterns.md` |
| --- | --- |
| Menu from a button | Dropdown |
| Switch between panels | Tabs |
| Expand and collapse sections | Accordion |
| Blocking dialog | Modal |
| Side panel | Drawer |
| Transient messages | Toast |
| Click-to-sort columns | Table sorting |
| Paged lists | Pagination (local demo; for real navigation use anchors with real URLs) |
| Unread indicator with a list | Notification disclosure (badge dot) |

## Verifying

After wiring a pattern, test: mouse, keyboard only, repeated open and close, Escape, clicking outside, a disabled item, and a narrow viewport. Run an automated check such as axe on the page.

<!-- skill: netframe-theming -->

# Theming NetFrame

Every design value is a CSS custom property on `:root`. Override a token with plain CSS; no rebuild. The full default list and every theme's overrides are in `references/tokens.md`.

## Override tokens

```css
:root {
  --nf-color-primary: #bd00ff;
  --nf-color-on-primary: #000000; /* always update the matching on-* colour */
}

.my-section { --nf-color-primary: #ff6b00; } /* scoped override */
```

Only override token names that appear in `references/tokens.md`.

## Alternate themes

Import `netframe/dist/themes.css`, then add one class to `<html>` or any container: `nf-theme-night-city`, `nf-theme-chiba-city`, `nf-theme-neon-80s`, `nf-theme-renaissance`, `nf-theme-code-rain`, `nf-theme-iron-signal`. No class means the default palette.

```js
// Validate before applying; the docs site stores the choice under "nf-theme".
const THEME = /^nf-theme-[a-z0-9-]+$/;
function applyTheme(name) {
  const root = document.documentElement;
  [...root.classList].forEach((c) => THEME.test(c) && root.classList.remove(c));
  if (THEME.test(name)) root.classList.add(name);
  try { localStorage.setItem('nf-theme', name); } catch { /* storage blocked */ }
}
```

Apply the saved class before first paint (a tiny inline script in `<head>`) to avoid a flash. Wrap storage access in `try/catch`; it can be blocked.

## Contrast rules for custom palettes

NetFrame's own palettes keep brand colours at 4.5:1 or better as text on every surface token, and every fill at 4.5:1 against its `on-*` colour. A custom palette must do the same.

- A brand colour used as text must reach 4.5:1 against `--nf-color-bg` and each `--nf-color-surface-*` token.
- Change `--nf-color-primary`, `-secondary` or `-tertiary` together with their `on-*` pair and the `-dim` variant.
- Hover states swap the foreground along with the background; verify them.
- Test with a contrast checker or axe; do not eyeball neon colours.

## Fonts

Typography tokens are `--nf-font-display`, `--nf-font-body`, `--nf-font-mono`, `--nf-font-label`. Bundled fonts (Space Grotesk, JetBrains Mono, VT323, Orbitron, Russo One) are self-hosted under their SIL OFL licences; keep the `fonts/` directory and its licence files with the CSS when you redistribute.

## Gotchas

- Themes override tokens only. Component rules still read tokens, so a theme change recolours everything.
- Iron Signal removes transition durations on purpose; do not "fix" that.
- Keep `border-radius: 0` tokens at zero; the hard edge is the design.

---

<!-- skill: netframe-usage -->

# Using NetFrame

NetFrame is plain CSS: `nf-*` classes and `--nf-*` custom properties. It has no JavaScript runtime and no framework dependency; it works in any markup. Docs: https://netframe.cybeartech.com

## Rules that prevent most mistakes

1. **Use only classes listed in `references/classes.md`.** Every class there exists in the shipped CSS. Do not invent `nf-` names or Tailwind-style utilities. If something is missing, write a small custom rule using tokens.
2. **Base class plus modifier.** `nf-button` is required, then add `nf-button-primary`, `nf-button-lg`, and so on. A modifier alone does nothing.
3. **Use tokens, not literals.** Colours, spacing and fonts come from `var(--nf-color-*)`, `var(--nf-space-*)`, `var(--nf-font-*)`. Never hard-code hex values that a token covers.
4. **Keep the hard-edged look.** `border-radius: 0`, hard offset shadows, `cursor: crosshair` on interactive elements. Do not add rounded corners, soft drop shadows or `cursor: pointer`.
5. **CSS only means behaviour is yours.** Dropdowns, tabs, accordions, modals, drawers, toasts, table sorting and pagination need JavaScript you provide. Load the `netframe-interactive` skill before building any of them.

## Install and import

```sh
npm install netframe
```

```js
import 'netframe/dist/netframe.css';
import 'netframe/dist/themes.css'; // optional: six alternate palettes
```

- Compiled CSS loads fonts from `./fonts/` next to the CSS file. A bundler copies them; for static hosting copy `node_modules/netframe/dist/fonts/` beside the stylesheet.
- No bundler: `<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://unpkg.com/netframe/dist/netframe.min.css">`.
- Sass: `@use 'pkg:netframe/scss/netframe' with ($nf-font-path: '/assets/fonts');` requires Dart Sass's Node package importer. `$nf-font-path` defaults to `../fonts`.
- Add `class="nf-crt"` to `<body>` for the CRT scanline overlay. It is decorative and ignores pointer events.
- Themes and token overrides: load the `netframe-theming` skill.

## Accessibility contract

NetFrame styles states; you supply the semantics.

- Every form control needs a `<label for>`; link helper or error text with `aria-describedby`; mark invalid fields with `aria-invalid="true"` (styled like `nf-input-error`).
- Progress bars and rings need `role="progressbar"`, an accessible name and `aria-valuenow/min/max`. Omit `aria-valuenow` when indeterminate.
- Links styled as buttons stay `<a class="nf-button">`; do not add `role="button"`.
- Interactive state lives in ARIA attributes with literal string values (`aria-expanded="false"`).
- Do not remove focus styles. Keep text at 4.5:1 contrast against its surface when you introduce colours.
- Spinners and animated utilities respect `prefers-reduced-motion`; keep a visible text label for loading states.
- The unread dot (`nf-badge-dot`) is decorative. Always pair it with text that states the count or status.

## Workflow

1. Look up each component in `references/classes.md` and read its docs page for markup structure.
2. Write markup using only those classes; add any custom styles with tokens.
3. For anything with behaviour, copy the matching controller from the `netframe-interactive` skill.
4. Check keyboard use, focus visibility, labels and contrast before finishing.

## Components and utilities

Components: accordion, avatar, badge, breadcrumb, button, card, divider, drawer, dropdown, input (field, select, textarea, checkbox, radio, range), modal, pagination, progress, skeleton, spinner, table, tabs, tag, toast, tooltip. Utility groups: glow and shadows, scanlines and CRT, glitch, layout. The per-class tables are in `references/classes.md`.

# NetFrame class reference

Every class below exists in the shipped CSS. A dash means the docs page does not describe it; read the page.

## Accordion (component)

Docs: https://netframe.cybeartech.com/components/accordion/

| Class | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `nf-accordion` | Outer wrapper |
| `nf-accordion-body` | Inner content with padding |
| `nf-accordion-content` | Animated height wrapper — set `height` via JS |
| `nf-accordion-icon` | CSS caret — flips when trigger has `aria-expanded="true"` |
| `nf-accordion-item` | Individual collapsible section |
| `nf-accordion-trigger` | Clickable header button — set `aria-expanded` |

## Avatar (component)

Docs: https://netframe.cybeartech.com/components/avatar/

| Class | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `nf-avatar` | Base container — default 2.5rem, primary border |
| `nf-avatar-group` | Flex wrapper that overlaps children |
| `nf-avatar-initials` | Text fallback inside the avatar |
| `nf-avatar-lg` | 3.5rem |
| `nf-avatar-secondary` | Secondary border + initials color |
| `nf-avatar-sm` | 2rem |
| `nf-avatar-status` | Status dot — position absolute, bottom-right |
| `nf-avatar-status-away` | Warning yellow dot |
| `nf-avatar-status-busy` | Error red dot |
| `nf-avatar-status-offline` | Subtle grey dot |
| `nf-avatar-status-online` | Primary green dot |
| `nf-avatar-tertiary` | Tertiary border + initials color |
| `nf-avatar-xl` | 5rem |
| `nf-avatar-xs` | 1.5rem |

| `nf-sr-only` | Visually hidden but available to assistive technology |
| `nf-text-error` | Text colour: `--nf-color-error` |
| `nf-text-muted` | Color: `--nf-color-text-muted` |
| `nf-text-primary` | Color: `--nf-color-primary` |
| `nf-text-secondary` | Color: `--nf-color-secondary` |
| `nf-text-subtle` | Color: `--nf-color-text-subtle` |
| `nf-text-tertiary` | Color: `--nf-color-tertiary` |
| `nf-tracking-display` | `letter-spacing: 0.05em` |
| `nf-truncate` | Single-line truncation with ellipsis |
| `nf-uppercase` | `text-transform: uppercase` |

## Scanlines (utility group)

Docs: https://netframe.cybeartech.com/utilities/scanlines/

| Class | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `nf-crt` | Full-screen fixed CRT overlay on `::before`. Add to `<body>`. |
| `nf-pixel-grid` | Dot-matrix pixel grid texture. |
| `nf-pixel-grid-dense` | Dense pixel grid |
| `nf-pixel-grid-subtle` | Faint pixel grid |
| `nf-scanlines` | Inline scanline overlay scoped to the element. |
| `nf-scanlines-animated` | Animated scanline sweep, primary colour |
| `nf-scanlines-animated-secondary` | Animated scanline sweep, secondary colour |
| `nf-scanlines-clip` | Clips an inline-scanline element's overflow |
| `nf-scanlines-heavy` | Stronger inline scanlines |

# NetFrame interactive patterns

NetFrame ships CSS only. These optional controllers are copied from the docs and run in the docs test suite. State lives in ARIA attributes; use unique `id`s per instance.

## Accordion

Docs: https://netframe.cybeartech.com/components/accordion/

Reference markup:

```html
<div class="nf-accordion">
  <div class="nf-accordion-item">
    <button class="nf-accordion-trigger" aria-expanded="true" aria-controls="panel-1">SYSTEM_STATUS<span class="nf-accordion-icon"></span></button>
    <div class="nf-accordion-content" id="panel-1">
      <div class="nf-accordion-body">All subsystems nominal. Uplink active.</div>
    </div>
  </div>
  <div class="nf-accordion-item">
    <button class="nf-accordion-trigger" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="panel-2">NETWORK_LOGS<span class="nf-accordion-icon"></span></button>
    <div class="nf-accordion-content" id="panel-2" style="height: 0;">
      <div class="nf-accordion-body">No anomalies detected in the last 24h.</div>
    </div>
  </div>
  <div class="nf-accordion-item">
    <button class="nf-accordion-trigger" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="panel-3">THREAT_ANALYSIS<span class="nf-accordion-icon"></span></button>
    <div class="nf-accordion-content" id="panel-3" style="height: 0;">
      <div class="nf-accordion-body">0 active threats. ICE integrity at 100%.</div>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>
```

Controller:

```js
document.querySelectorAll('.nf-accordion-trigger').forEach((trigger) => {
  const panel = document.getElementById(trigger.getAttribute('aria-controls'));
  if (!panel) return;

  function setExpanded(expanded) {
    trigger.setAttribute('aria-expanded', String(expanded));
    // `inert` keeps links/buttons inside a collapsed panel out of the tab order
    // and the accessibility tree, which `height: 0` alone does not.
    panel.inert = !expanded;
    panel.style.height = expanded ? panel.scrollHeight + 'px' : '0';
    if (expanded && matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches) panel.style.height = 'auto';
  }

  // Release the fixed height after expanding so content can reflow/resize.
  panel.addEventListener('transitionend', () => {
    if (trigger.getAttribute('aria-expanded') === 'true') panel.style.height = 'auto';
  });

  const initiallyOpen = trigger.getAttribute('aria-expanded') === 'true';
  setExpanded(initiallyOpen);
  if (initiallyOpen) panel.style.height = 'auto'; // no transition runs on load

  trigger.addEventListener('click', () => {
    const expanded = trigger.getAttribute('aria-expanded') === 'true';
    if (expanded) {
      // Pin the current height first so the collapse can animate from it.
      panel.style.height = panel.scrollHeight + 'px';
      panel.offsetHeight; // force reflow
    }
    setExpanded(!expanded);
  });
});
```

## Dropdown

Docs: https://netframe.cybeartech.com/components/dropdown/

Reference markup:

```html
<div class="nf-dropdown">
  <button class="nf-button nf-button-ghost nf-dropdown-trigger" aria-expanded="true" aria-haspopup="menu">OPTIONS</button>
  <ul class="nf-dropdown-menu" role="menu">
    <li role="none"><button class="nf-dropdown-item" role="menuitem">SCAN_NODE</button></li>
    <li role="none"><button class="nf-dropdown-item" role="menuitem">PURGE_CACHE</button></li>
    <li role="none"><button class="nf-dropdown-item" role="menuitem" aria-disabled="true">SYNC_DATA</button></li>
  </ul>
</div>
```

Controller:

```js
document.querySelectorAll('.nf-dropdown').forEach((dropdown) => {
  const trigger = dropdown.querySelector('.nf-dropdown-trigger');
  const menu    = dropdown.querySelector('.nf-dropdown-menu');
  const items   = () => [...menu.querySelectorAll('.nf-dropdown-item:not([aria-disabled="true"]):not(:disabled)')];

  // The CSS hides the menu only for aria-hidden="true" (or .nf-hidden),
  // so always write the literal string rather than toggling the attribute.
  function setOpen(open, { focusTrigger = false, focusItem = open } = {}) {
    trigger.setAttribute('aria-expanded', String(open));
    menu.setAttribute('aria-hidden', String(!open));
    if (open && focusItem) items()[0]?.focus();
    else if (focusTrigger) trigger.focus();
  }

  // Synchronize initial ARIA state without moving focus on page load.
  setOpen(trigger.getAttribute('aria-expanded') === 'true', { focusItem: false });

  trigger.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
    e.stopPropagation();
    setOpen(trigger.getAttribute('aria-expanded') !== 'true');
  });

  // Arrow keys move between items; Escape closes and returns focus.
  menu.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
    const list = items();
    const i = list.indexOf(document.activeElement);
    if (e.key === 'ArrowDown') { e.preventDefault(); list[(i + 1) % list.length]?.focus(); }
    if (e.key === 'ArrowUp')   { e.preventDefault(); list[(i - 1 + list.length) % list.length]?.focus(); }
    if (e.key === 'Escape')    { setOpen(false, { focusTrigger: true }); }
  });

  // Close on outside click
  document.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
    if (!dropdown.contains(e.target)) setOpen(false);
  });
});
```

## Tabs

Docs: https://netframe.cybeartech.com/components/tabs/

Reference markup:

```html
<div class="nf-tabs">
  <div class="nf-tab-list" role="tablist" aria-label="System modules">
    <button class="nf-tab" role="tab" aria-selected="true" aria-controls="tab-panel-1" id="tab-1">OVERVIEW</button>
    <button class="nf-tab" role="tab" aria-selected="false" aria-controls="tab-panel-2" id="tab-2">NETWORK</button>
    <button class="nf-tab" role="tab" aria-selected="false" aria-controls="tab-panel-3" id="tab-3">SECURITY</button>
    <button class="nf-tab" role="tab" aria-selected="false" aria-controls="tab-panel-4" id="tab-4" aria-disabled="true">ARCHIVE</button>
  </div>
  <div class="nf-tab-panel" role="tabpanel" id="tab-panel-1" aria-labelledby="tab-1">
    System overview data goes here.
  </div>
  <div class="nf-tab-panel" role="tabpanel" id="tab-panel-2" aria-labelledby="tab-2" hidden>
    Network topology data goes here.
  </div>
  <div class="nf-tab-panel" role="tabpanel" id="tab-panel-3" aria-labelledby="tab-3" hidden>
    Security logs go here.
  </div>
  <div class="nf-tab-panel" role="tabpanel" id="tab-panel-4" aria-labelledby="tab-4" hidden>
    Archive data goes here.
  </div>
</div>
```

Controller:

```js
document.querySelectorAll('.nf-tab-list').forEach((list) => {
  const tabs = [...list.querySelectorAll('.nf-tab')];
  const enabled = () => tabs.filter((t) => t.getAttribute('aria-disabled') !== 'true' && !t.disabled);

  function select(tab, { focus = false } = {}) {
    if (!tab || tab.getAttribute('aria-disabled') === 'true' || tab.disabled) return;
    tabs.forEach((t) => {
      const active = t === tab;
      t.setAttribute('aria-selected', String(active));
      t.tabIndex = active ? 0 : -1; // roving tabindex: one tab stop per list
      document.getElementById(t.getAttribute('aria-controls'))?.toggleAttribute('hidden', !active);
    });
    if (focus) tab.focus();
  }

  select(enabled().find((t) => t.getAttribute('aria-selected') === 'true') ?? enabled()[0]);

  list.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
    const tab = e.target.closest('.nf-tab');
    if (tab) select(tab);
  });

  // Arrow keys / Home / End move between enabled tabs (automatic activation).
  list.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
    const order = enabled();
    const i = order.indexOf(document.activeElement);
    const next = {
      ArrowRight: order[(i + 1) % order.length],
      ArrowLeft: order[(i - 1 + order.length) % order.length],
      Home: order[0],
      End: order[order.length - 1],
    }[e.key];
    if (next) { e.preventDefault(); select(next, { focus: true }); }
  });
});
```

## Modal

Docs: https://netframe.cybeartech.com/components/modal/

Reference markup:

```html
<!-- Overlay -->
<div class="nf-modal-overlay" id="modal-overlay" role="presentation">

  <!-- Dialog -->
  <div class="nf-modal" role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-labelledby="modal-title" tabindex="-1">
    <div class="nf-modal-header">
      <h2 class="nf-modal-title" id="modal-title">CONFIRM_ACTION</h2>
      <button class="nf-modal-close" aria-label="Close">✕</button>
    </div>
    <div class="nf-modal-body">
      <p>This action will purge all cached node data. Proceed?</p>
    </div>
    <div class="nf-modal-footer">
      <button class="nf-button nf-button-ghost">CANCEL</button>
      <button class="nf-button nf-button-danger">PURGE</button>
    </div>
  </div>

</div>
```

Controller:

```js
const overlay = document.getElementById('modal-overlay');
const modal   = overlay.querySelector('.nf-modal');
const trigger = document.getElementById('open-modal');
const close   = modal.querySelector('.nf-modal-close');
const FOCUSABLE = 'a[href], button:not([disabled]), input:not([disabled]), select:not([disabled]), textarea:not([disabled]), [tabindex]:not([tabindex="-1"])';
let isOpen = false;

function openModal() {
  isOpen = true;
  overlay.classList.remove('nf-hidden');
  overlay.removeAttribute('aria-hidden');
  // Keep keyboard and screen-reader focus out of the page behind the dialog.
  overlay.parentElement.querySelectorAll(':scope > :not(#modal-overlay)').forEach((el) => (el.inert = true));
  modal.focus();
}

function closeModal() {
  if (!isOpen) return; // Escape on a closed modal must not steal focus.
  isOpen = false;
  overlay.classList.add('nf-hidden');
  overlay.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');
  overlay.parentElement.querySelectorAll(':scope > [inert]').forEach((el) => (el.inert = false));
  trigger.focus();
}

trigger.addEventListener('click', openModal);
close.addEventListener('click', closeModal);
overlay.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
  if (e.target === overlay) closeModal();
});
document.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
  if (!isOpen) return;
  if (e.key === 'Escape') closeModal();
  if (e.key === 'Tab') {
    // Wrap focus inside the dialog.
    const items = [...modal.querySelectorAll(FOCUSABLE)];
    const first = items[0], last = items[items.length - 1];
    if (e.shiftKey && document.activeElement === first) { e.preventDefault(); last.focus(); }
    else if (!e.shiftKey && document.activeElement === last) { e.preventDefault(); first.focus(); }
  }
});
```

## Drawer

Docs: https://netframe.cybeartech.com/components/drawer/

Reference markup:

```html
<button class="nf-button" id="open-drawer">OPEN DRAWER</button>

<!-- Overlay and drawer: direct children of <body>, closed by default -->
<div class="nf-drawer-overlay nf-hidden" id="drawer-overlay"></div>

<!-- Left drawer -->
<div class="nf-drawer nf-drawer-left" id="my-drawer" role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-hidden="true" aria-labelledby="drawer-title">
  <div class="nf-drawer-header">
    <h2 class="nf-drawer-title" id="drawer-title">SYSTEM_NAV</h2>
    <button class="nf-button nf-button-ghost nf-button-icon" aria-label="Close drawer">✕</button>
  </div>
  <div class="nf-drawer-body">
    <p>Drawer content goes here.</p>
  </div>
  <div class="nf-drawer-footer">
    <button class="nf-button nf-button-ghost nf-button-sm">CLOSE</button>
  </div>
</div>
```

Controller:

```js
const overlay = document.getElementById('drawer-overlay');
const drawer  = document.getElementById('my-drawer');
const trigger = document.getElementById('open-drawer');
const close   = drawer.querySelector('[aria-label="Close drawer"]');
const FOCUSABLE = 'a[href], button:not([disabled]), input:not([disabled]), select:not([disabled]), textarea:not([disabled]), [tabindex]:not([tabindex="-1"])';
let isOpen = false;

// Everything else under <body> becomes inert while the drawer is open.
const page = () => overlay.parentElement.querySelectorAll(':scope > :not(#drawer-overlay):not(#my-drawer)');

function setOpen(open, { moveFocus = true } = {}) {
  if (open === isOpen && moveFocus) return;
  isOpen = open;
  drawer.classList.toggle('nf-open', open);
  overlay.classList.toggle('nf-hidden', !open);
  drawer.setAttribute('aria-hidden', String(!open));
  // The closed panel sits off-screen but is still focusable unless inert.
  drawer.inert = !open;
  page().forEach((el) => (el.inert = open));
  if (!moveFocus) return;
  if (open) (drawer.querySelector(FOCUSABLE) ?? drawer).focus();
  else trigger.focus();
}

setOpen(drawer.classList.contains('nf-open'), { moveFocus: false });

trigger.addEventListener('click', () => setOpen(true));
close.addEventListener('click', () => setOpen(false));
drawer.querySelectorAll('.nf-drawer-footer button').forEach((b) => b.addEventListener('click', () => setOpen(false)));
overlay.addEventListener('click', () => setOpen(false));
document.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
  if (!isOpen) return;
  if (e.key === 'Escape') setOpen(false);
  if (e.key === 'Tab') {
    // Wrap focus inside the drawer.
    const items = [...drawer.querySelectorAll(FOCUSABLE)];
    const first = items[0], last = items[items.length - 1];
    if (e.shiftKey && document.activeElement === first) { e.preventDefault(); last.focus(); }
    else if (!e.shiftKey && document.activeElement === last) { e.preventDefault(); first.focus(); }
  }
});
```

## Toast

Docs: https://netframe.cybeartech.com/components/toast/

Reference markup:

```html
<div class="nf-toast nf-toast-success">
  <div class="nf-toast-content">
    <div class="nf-toast-title">UPLINK_RESTORED</div>
    <div class="nf-toast-message">Connection re-established. Latency: 12ms.</div>
  </div>
  <button class="nf-toast-close" aria-label="Dismiss">✕</button>
</div>

<div class="nf-toast nf-toast-error">
  <div class="nf-toast-content">
    <div class="nf-toast-title">CONNECTION_LOST</div>
    <div class="nf-toast-message">Node 047 unreachable. Retrying in 5s.</div>
  </div>
  <button class="nf-toast-close" aria-label="Dismiss">✕</button>
</div>

<div class="nf-toast nf-toast-warning">
  <div class="nf-toast-content">
    <div class="nf-toast-title">HIGH_LATENCY</div>
    <div class="nf-toast-message">Uplink degraded. Current latency: 420ms.</div>
  </div>
  <button class="nf-toast-close" aria-label="Dismiss">✕</button>
</div>

<div class="nf-toast nf-toast-info">
  <div class="nf-toast-content">
    <div class="nf-toast-title">SYNC_COMPLETE</div>
    <div class="nf-toast-message">48 records synchronized with remote node.</div>
  </div>
  <button class="nf-toast-close" aria-label="Dismiss">✕</button>
</div>
```

Controller:

```js
function showToast({ title, message, type = 'info', duration = 4000 }) {
  const region = document.getElementById('toast-region');
  const toast = document.createElement('div');
  toast.className = `nf-toast nf-toast-${type}`;
  // Errors interrupt; everything else waits for the polite region.
  if (type === 'error') toast.setAttribute('role', 'alert');

  // Build with textContent, never innerHTML: titles and messages often
  // contain user or server data.
  const content = document.createElement('div');
  content.className = 'nf-toast-content';
  const heading = document.createElement('div');
  heading.className = 'nf-toast-title';
  heading.textContent = title;
  const body = document.createElement('div');
  body.className = 'nf-toast-message';
  body.textContent = message;
  content.append(heading, body);

  const close = document.createElement('button');
  close.type = 'button';
  close.className = 'nf-toast-close';
  close.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Dismiss');
  close.textContent = '✕';
  toast.append(content, close);

  let timer;
  let removed = false;
  const remove = () => {
    if (removed) return;
    removed = true;
    toast.remove();
  };
  const dismiss = () => {
    clearTimeout(timer);
    toast.classList.add('nf-toast-dismissing');
    toast.addEventListener('animationend', remove, { once: true });
    setTimeout(remove, 1000); // fallback if animations are disabled
  };
  const start = () => { clearTimeout(timer); timer = setTimeout(dismiss, duration); };
  const pause = () => clearTimeout(timer);

  // Let people stop the timer while reading or interacting (WCAG 2.2.1).
  toast.addEventListener('mouseenter', pause);
  toast.addEventListener('mouseleave', start);
  toast.addEventListener('focusin', pause);
  toast.addEventListener('focusout', start);
  close.addEventListener('click', dismiss);

  region.appendChild(toast);
  start();
  return toast;
}
```

## Table sorting

Docs: https://netframe.cybeartech.com/components/table/

Controller:

```js
document.querySelectorAll('.nf-table').forEach((table) => {
  const headers = [...table.querySelectorAll('thead th')];
  const body = table.querySelector('tbody');
  if (!body) return;
  const collator = new Intl.Collator(undefined, { numeric: true, sensitivity: 'base' });
  const value = (row, column) => row.cells[column].textContent.trim();
  const missing = (text) => text === '' || text === '—';
  const numeric = (text) => /^-?\d+(?:\.\d+)?(?:ms|%|MB)?$/i.test(text);
  headers.forEach((header, column) => {
    const button = header.querySelector('.nf-table-sort');
    if (!button) return;
    button.addEventListener('click', () => {
      const direction = header.getAttribute('aria-sort') === 'ascending' ? -1 : 1;
      const rows = [...body.rows].sort((a, b) => {
        const x = value(a, column);
        const y = value(b, column);
        if (missing(x) || missing(y)) return Number(missing(x)) - Number(missing(y));
        const order = numeric(x) && numeric(y)
          ? parseFloat(x) - parseFloat(y)
          : collator.compare(x, y);
        return order * direction;
      });
      headers.forEach((other) => other.removeAttribute('aria-sort'));
      header.setAttribute('aria-sort', direction === 1 ? 'ascending' : 'descending');
      body.append(...rows);
    });
  });
});
```

## Pagination

Docs: https://netframe.cybeartech.com/components/pagination/

Required container markup (see the docs page for the full example): `<div data-pagination data-pages="N" data-page="1"><nav aria-label="Pagination"><ol class="nf-pagination"></ol></nav><p data-page-status role="status"></p><ul data-page-results></ul></div>`. The controller rebuilds the list items.

Controller:

```js
document.querySelectorAll('[data-pagination]').forEach((demo) => {
  const pages = Number(demo.dataset.pages);
  let current = Number(demo.dataset.page);
  const list = demo.querySelector('.nf-pagination');
  const status = demo.querySelector('[data-page-status]');
  const results = demo.querySelector('[data-page-results]');
  const records = Array.from({ length: pages * 3 }, (_, i) => 'NODE_' + String(i + 1).padStart(3, '0'));

  function render(focusAction) {
    const numbers = pages <= 7
      ? Array.from({ length: pages }, (_, i) => i + 1)
      : [1, ...[current - 1, current, current + 1].filter((p) => p > 1 && p < pages), pages];
    list.replaceChildren();
    function control(label, page, action) {
      const item = document.createElement('li');
      item.className = 'nf-page-item';
      const button = document.createElement('button');
      button.type = 'button';
      button.className = 'nf-page-link' + (action === 'page' ? '' : ' nf-page-' + action);
      button.textContent = label;
      button.dataset.page = String(page);
      button.dataset.action = action;
      if (action === 'page' && page === current) {
        item.classList.add('nf-page-item-active');
        button.setAttribute('aria-current', 'page');
      }
      if (page < 1 || page > pages) {
        item.classList.add('nf-page-item-disabled');
        button.disabled = true;
        button.setAttribute('aria-disabled', 'true');
      }
      item.append(button);
      list.append(item);
    }
    control('PREV', current - 1, 'prev');
    numbers.forEach((page, i) => {
      if (i && page - numbers[i - 1] > 1) {
        const item = document.createElement('li');
        item.className = 'nf-page-item nf-page-ellipsis';
        const dots = document.createElement('span');
        dots.className = 'nf-page-link';
        dots.textContent = '…';
        dots.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');
        item.append(dots);
        list.append(item);
      }
      control(String(page), page, 'page');
    });
    control('NEXT', current + 1, 'next');
    demo.dataset.page = String(current);
    status.textContent = 'Page ' + current + ' of ' + pages;
    results.replaceChildren(...records.slice((current - 1) * 3, current * 3).map((record) => {
      const item = document.createElement('li');
      item.textContent = record;
      return item;
    }));
    if (focusAction) {
      const candidate = list.querySelector('[data-action="' + focusAction + '"]:not(:disabled)');
      (focusAction === 'page' ? list.querySelector('[aria-current="page"]') : candidate || list.querySelector('[aria-current="page"]')).focus();
    }
  }

  demo.addEventListener('click', (event) => {
    const button = event.target.closest('button[data-page]');
    if (!button || button.disabled) return;
    const page = Number(button.dataset.page);
    if (page < 1 || page > pages || page === current) return;
    current = page;
    render(button.dataset.action);
  });
  render();
});
```

## Notification disclosure (badge dot)

Docs: https://netframe.cybeartech.com/components/badge/

Needs the container with `data-notifications`, a trigger with `data-notification-trigger`, a hidden `.notification-panel`, and `data-notification-count`, `data-notification-label`, `data-notification-status`, `data-mark-read` hooks. Copy the full HTML and demo-only CSS from the docs page.

Controller:

```js
document.querySelectorAll('[data-notifications]').forEach((root) => {
  const trigger = root.querySelector('[data-notification-trigger]');
  const panel = root.querySelector('.notification-panel');
  const status = root.querySelector('[data-notification-status]');
  const count = root.querySelector('[data-notification-count]');
  const label = root.querySelector('[data-notification-label]');
  const markRead = root.querySelector('[data-mark-read]');

  function setOpen(open) {
    trigger.setAttribute('aria-expanded', String(open));
    panel.hidden = !open;
  }

  trigger.addEventListener('click', () => {
    setOpen(trigger.getAttribute('aria-expanded') !== 'true');
  });

  markRead.addEventListener('click', () => {
    if (markRead.getAttribute('aria-disabled') === 'true') return;
    root.querySelectorAll('[data-unread]').forEach((item) => {
      item.removeAttribute('data-unread');
      const state = item.querySelector('.notification-item-state');
      state.textContent = state.textContent.replace('UNREAD', 'READ');
    });
    trigger.classList.remove('nf-badge-dot');
    count.textContent = '0';
    label.textContent = ' — no unread notifications';
    status.textContent = 'All notifications read';
    markRead.textContent = 'ALL READ';
    markRead.setAttribute('aria-disabled', 'true');
  });

  document.addEventListener('click', (event) => {
    if (!root.contains(event.target)) setOpen(false);
  });
  document.addEventListener('keydown', (event) => {
    if (event.key !== 'Escape' || trigger.getAttribute('aria-expanded') !== 'true') return;
    event.preventDefault();
    setOpen(false);
    trigger.focus();
  });
  root.addEventListener('focusout', (event) => {
    if (!root.contains(event.relatedTarget)) setOpen(false);
  });
});
```
